text: Childminder here, looking after a 6 year old boy overnight while his parents travel back. Temp is 38.5. He's got a blotchy pinkish rash on his back and tummy which goes pale when I press a glass on it. But there are also some small purple spots on his lower legs that don't fade at all under the glass, I checked a few times. Parents are aware and I'm keeping an eye on him. Please advise.
